definition_english: A fictitious front enterprise or cover company maintained solely for clandestine operations.
definition_hindi: केवल गुप्त अभियानों के संचालन हेतु बनाया और चलाया गया कोई काल्पनिक या फ़र्ज़ी आवरण उद्यम।

etymology.root_language: Latin (via Middle English and Medieval Latin)
forms: English countable noun notional / notionals (espionage conversion)
etymology.historical_development: Derived by conversion (zero-derivation) from the English adjective notional (notion + -al). Recorded as a rare countable noun (plural notionals) in espionage and intelligence usage in opened English Wiktionary; historical first attestation date for S6 is Not yet established.

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: Intelligence and espionage tradecraft jargon; rare outside clandestine-operations contexts
register_and_pragmatics.connotation: Denotes deliberate institutional artifice or covert front status maintained for clandestine operations
cultural_nuances: Attested in opened research only as an English espionage jargon noun; no established Hindi equivalent was found in CSTT, Hindi dictionaries, or opened Indian official and academic corpora.
usage_restrictions: Do not conflate the countable espionage noun (a notional / notionals) with adjectival senses S1–S5.
Do not translate S6 with unrelated adjectival equivalents from other senses (अवधारणात्मक, धारणात्मक, आनुमानिक, सैद्धांतिक) or documented dictionary errors (अभियात्मक, छिद्रान्वेषी, कल्चरल बैंक).
Until corpus evidence establishes a standard Hindi term, use provisional transliteration (नोशनल) or explicit contextual paraphrase.

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: Unlike S1–S5 where English notional functions as an adjective, S6 is a countable noun (singular notional, plural notionals) formed by zero-derivation from the adjective.
linguistic_analysis.hindi_lexical_gap: No established single-word Hindi noun equivalent was located in CSTT, Hindwi Dictionary, Shabdkosh, or opened government and university texts.

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Designates a concrete but fictitious front enterprise or cover company maintained solely for clandestine intelligence operations, distinguishing it from philosophical abstraction (S1), legally binding administrative pay/promotion reckonings (S2), financial/tax calculation bases (S3), semantic grammatical concord (S4), and whimsical temperament (S5).
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Strictly confined to espionage and intelligence tradecraft; separate from all five adjectival senses S1–S5.
